entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You seem quite busy, Sae-san. I take it[n]you're stuck in the middle of everything?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves made a mockery[n]of us when they brought down[n]Kaneshiro...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And to make matters worse, Medjed,[n]who has been dormant for some time[n]now, just declared war on them.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: How much more can they screw us over?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Stress is bad for the skin, you know.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Did you come all this way simply to be[n]sarcastic?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: How about you listen to my deductions[n]for a change of pace?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You may think it absurd...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But don't you think the case you're[n]pursuing and the actions of the Phantom[n]Thieves overlap somehow?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: What are you basing this off of?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The one point of commonality across[n]all cases is how those involved have an[n]unforeseen change of heart.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I've suspected that myself, but those[n]suspicions are unfounded.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I told you at the beginning that this was[n]only a deduction.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: These "just" Phantom Thieves are riling[n]up the public. However, that is a disguise.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Their true goal is terrorist action by way[n]of psychotic breakdowns... Is that too[n]much?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: There's nothing at the moment that[n]falsifies that claim.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Have you mentioned this to the police?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'd never tell them such things.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The only value they have to me is in their[n]mobility and organizational capabilities.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Hm, it seems having you lend me a hand[n]has paid off.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm glad to hear that. What about your[n]case, Sae-san?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Did you learn anything from the[n]guardian of that mental shutdown[n]victim's daughter?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Nothing at all.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I see.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Now, what should my next action be[n]for our victory?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Handle the Phantom Thieves. Without[n]remorse.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Use any means necessary to win. That's[n]how I would deal with them.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: *chuckle* Very well.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: This seems to be fun for you. Are you[n]on to something?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No, not at all.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well then, to our victory.
